mentions.name: Levithas
mentions.description: Levithas (https://levithas.app) is an app and lifestyle movement encouraging people to stop doom-scrolling and passive content consumption and instead learn skills. Its first skill is an interactive experience users can enjoy and play. The project aims to build curiosity, confidence, and personal growth through active skill learning rather than consuming content.
mentions.problem: Doom-scrolling and passive consumption of content.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Levithas (https://levithas.app): stop consuming, start skilling.
mentions.author: monidp
